summary: A Yes vote imposes a $50 annual parcel tax for 10 years within the City of Fort Bragg to fund fire protection equipment and emergency response services.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes a $50 annual parcel tax for 10 years to fund local fire protection services and equipment.
tax.quote: To maintain reliable local fire protection services; replace aging fire engines and emergency response equipment; keep funds locally controlled and unavailable for State use; and require annual audit and public reporting, shall the City of Fort Bragg authorize a $50 annual parcel tax for 10 years, generating approximately $123,900 annually?

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the proposed parcel tax.
